title: Ideal customer
lead: Who you want to sell to and who you do not. Agents use this to aim messages and find leads.

fields.label: Who do you sell to?
fields.hint: Such as: Homeowners with a budget set and a date in mind.

fields.label: Who do you not sell to?
fields.hint: Such as: Buyers who only want the lowest price.

fields.label: What do they usually ask for?
fields.hint: Such as: A modular kitchen, a wardrobe, a full flat.
